claim_judgments.rationale: The claim accurately captures the permission and conditions for accumulating satellite amounts of hazardous waste without a permit under paragraph (A).
The claim faithfully reflects the permission to comply with the satellite accumulation exemption instead of central accumulation area conditions, subject to paragraphs (A)(7) and (A)(8).
The claim correctly conveys the immediate transfer obligation when a container holding hazardous waste leaks or is not in good condition.
The claim correctly represents the container compatibility requirement set out in paragraph (A)(2).
The claim properly reflects the prohibition on co-locating incompatible wastes in the same container unless paragraph (B) of rule 3745-65-17 is satisfied.
The claim accurately states the prohibition against placing hazardous waste into unwashed containers previously holding incompatible materials.
The claim correctly articulates the separation or protection requirement for containers holding waste incompatible with nearby materials.
The claim correctly expresses the general closed container requirement and all enumerated exceptions for adding/removing/consolidating and temporary venting.

The claim summary and choice_text state that a generator must mark or label with 'either' the words Hazardous Waste 'or' an indication of the hazards, whereas paragraph (A)(5) uses the conjunction 'and', requiring both markings.
The claim summary and choice_text misstate the timeframe as thirty consecutive calendar days instead of three consecutive calendar days as required by paragraphs (A)(6)(a) and (A)(6)(b).
The claim accurately captures the dual obligations during the 3-day excess accumulation period to continue compliance with (A)(1)-(5) and mark the start date of excess accumulation.
The claim accurately captures the preparedness, prevention, and emergency procedure requirements applicable to small quantity generators under paragraph (A)(7).
The claim accurately captures the requirement that large quantity generators meet preparedness, prevention, and emergency procedures in rules 3745-52-250 to 3745-52-265 under paragraph (A)(8).
The claim correctly preserves the informational cross-reference comment to rule 3745-50-11 for incorporated publication dates.

Claim C0007 includes the explicit exception for temporary venting necessary for equipment operation.
Claim C0007 includes the explicit exception for temporary venting to prevent dangerous situations such as pressure build-up.
Claim C0008 incorrectly states that marking the words 'Hazardous Waste' is an alternative to marking hazard indications, rather than a mandatory conjunctive requirement.
Claim C0008 treats hazard indication as an alternative option rather than a mandatory requirement alongside the words 'Hazardous Waste'.
Claim C0009 erroneously alters the compliance timeframe from three consecutive calendar days to thirty consecutive calendar days.
Claim C0009 alters the required removal period from three consecutive calendar days to thirty consecutive calendar days.
